The Parliament of the Kingdom of Sicily ( Latin : Parlamentum Regni Siciliae [ 1 ] ), or Sicilian Parliament , was the legislature of the Kingdom of Sicily from the 11th century until 1816, and again in 1848 when it assembled in the context of the Sicilian revolution of independence of 1848 . Parliament evolved from the curiae generales of bishops, lords and cities representatives that advised the Sicilian monarch . [ 2 ]
